units.source_text: 为欲排遣哀思，照例起身盥洗，赴佛前诵经。

en.t: To dispel his sorrow, he rose as usual, washed and purified himself, and went before the Buddha to recite sutras.

units.source_text: 侍女们把埋好的炭火挖出，送上一个火钵去。

en.t: The serving women dug out the banked charcoal fire and brought him a brazier.

units.source_text: 亲近的侍女中纳言君和中将君在旁服侍，做他的话伴。

en.t: Among his close attendants, Lady Chuunagon and Lady Chuujou waited beside him and kept him company in conversation.

units.source_text: 源氏对她们说：“昨夜独寝，比往常更加寂寞呢。

en.t: Genji said to them, "Sleeping alone last night felt even lonelier than usual.

units.source_text: 我已习惯了清心寡欲的生涯，可是还有种种无聊的事羁绊着我。”

en.t: I have grown used to a life of purity and few desires, yet all sorts of trivial things still bind me."

units.source_text: 说罢长叹一声。

en.t: After saying this, he gave a long sigh.

units.source_text: 他看看这些侍女，想道：“如果我也离世出家，这些人将更加悲伤，实在是怪可怜的啊！”

en.t: Looking at these serving women, he thought, "If I too leave the world and take holy orders, these people will grieve all the more. How truly pitiable they are."

units.source_text: 听到源氏静悄悄地诵经念佛的声音，即使是无愁无恨之人，亦必泪流不止，

en.t: Hearing Genji quietly recite sutras and invoke the Buddha, even someone without sorrow or resentment would surely have been unable to stop weeping,

units.source_text: 何况这些朝夕伺候的侍女，她们的衣袖当不得止水之闸，感慨实无限量！

en.t: and all the more so these women who served him morning and evening; their sleeves could not dam the flow of tears, and their emotion was beyond measure.

units.source_text: 源氏对她们说：“我生在现世，荣华富贵，可说没有缺憾了。

en.t: Genji said to them, "Born into this present world, I have lacked nothing in glory, rank, and wealth.

units.source_text: 然而又不断地遭逢比别人更痛苦的厄运。

en.t: Yet again and again I have met misfortunes more painful than those of other people.

units.source_text: 想是佛菩萨要我感悟人生无常、世途多苦之理，所以赋给我这命运的吧。

en.t: Perhaps the Buddhas and bodhisattvas gave me this fate so that I might awaken to the truth that life is impermanent and the ways of the world are full of suffering.

units.source_text: 我懂得此理，却故意装作不知，因循度日，以致到了现在这晚年，

en.t: I understood this truth, yet deliberately pretended not to know it and let the days pass as they would, until now in my later years,

units.source_text: 还要遭逢这可悲之事。

en.t: I must still encounter this sorrowful event.

units.source_text: 我已分明看到了自己命途多舛、悟性迟钝，倒觉得安心了。

en.t: Now that I clearly see how troubled my fate is and how slow my understanding has been, I feel, strangely, at peace.

units.source_text: 今后我身已毫无羁绊。

en.t: From now on, there is nothing left to bind me.

units.source_text: 然而你们这一班人，对我都比从前更加亲近，

en.t: And yet all of you have become even dearer to me than before,

units.source_text: 使我在临行分手之时，又平添一种苦痛。

en.t: and so, at the moment when I must depart and part from you, another pain is added to my heart.

units.source_text: 唉，我心如此优柔寡断，实在太无聊了！”

en.t: Ah, for my heart to be so irresolute is truly wretched."

units.source_text: 他举手拭目，想掩住泪痕，然而遮掩不住，泪珠从衣袖上纷纷落下。

en.t: He raised his hand to wipe his eyes, trying to hide the traces of tears, but he could not conceal them, and drops of tears fell one after another from his sleeves.

units.source_text: 众侍女见此光景，眼泪更加流个不住。

en.t: Seeing this, the serving women wept even more uncontrollably.

units.source_text: 她们都不愿被源氏主君抛舍，各人都想向他诉苦，然而终于不说，只是饮泣吞声。

en.t: None of them wished to be abandoned by their lord Genji, and each wanted to pour out her grief to him, but in the end they said nothing and only swallowed their sobs.
